A Run Command by a caller other than Glorfindel and a Bastion shareable link, detected and escalated, refused attempts included; Glorfindel's own session drain never a card; a VM outside the discovery filed on its group, never dropped

A control-plane operation that names neither its caller nor its resource: a card of incomplete telemetry, of lower severity, never approvable, never dropped; the caller named from its token's ids when the log leaves it empty, on every operation of a summary card too; a reply of the journal out of the rule's schema, one card per rule and poll that says it unreadable, counted in the rule's status

A cloud detection's card is titled by its rule, in English: the eleven rules of the control plane and of Entra ID each declare a short title, checked at load; the card keeps it, from the rule alone; a rule without one and a card of before take the neutral title of the family; Discord and the CLI show it, the types and their guards unchanged

The watch says whether the workspace's logs still arrive: for each table its rules read, when its last log arrived, every 15 min on its Log Analytics budget, given to the console; a failed read said as such, never as no log, its ids masked; a table of the identity or the control plane silent past 24 h, one card an episode, closed when the logs come back or the table is no longer followed

The logs' freshness tells the console, for each table, whether the budget left it out (its last value kept) and its plane, read as the card reads it: a rule misfiled on Perf never makes Perf a card, a table two rules read takes the plane that opens one; an episode whose card could not be closed kept until it is, closed too when every rule is removed; a GUID stuck to a hex character masked, a `//` in a string no longer cutting a query

The logs' freshness reads again: its column no longer a word of KQL (`LastIngest`, never `last`, every read of 0.6.8 a 400), a guard on the text holding it, over every query string of glorfindel/ and the shipped rules (never the rules the model writes nor the client's); a failed read says Azure's inner error first, its cause, masked and cut

The silence of AuditLogs and SigninLogs judged by Entra: the watch reads on Graph Entra's last event older than the ingestion's delay ($top=1, read only, on a Graph budget of its own) and opens its card only when the workspace has not received it, closed only once the log catches up — a calm tenant never an alert, a busy one never hiding a cut; without the right (a 403) or Graph unreadable, the threshold of 7 days, said on the tile; the other tables of Entra keep 24 h; the right to read Entra's audit log, for the watch of Imladris, declared in Terraform, off until Jonathan's apply

The watch reads the readable name of each subscription it sees, its own and those of the discovered VMs: at the start, every 6 h and as soon as one appears, with its own identity, Reader enough; the name cleaned and cut, given to the console alone under a masked key, a failed read said as such

The lateness of each source, measured on the bench: read-only queries on the kept data, in the order the data leaves
The watch's own return channel no longer fires the exfiltration rule, set aside by its identity, its container and its objects, and counted; a card attributed to no VM says so, with its candidates

A card attributed to no VM is never approvable in one click, whatever gate held it first; its suggested commands never name the VM it is filed on; the return channel set aside under the shipped rule only
The watch's own return channel set aside when the query's writers arrive as text, as the SDK hands them on; a column unreadable sets nothing aside and is counted
The certificate Azure puts on a managed identity it creates makes no high card: set aside by the tenant's principal's id, never its name, and counted
An aggregated row whose gathered set grows, as the SDK hands it on in JSON, keeps its identity and makes no new card; the shipped rules' identities unchanged

The host's alerts read as signals, if the bench measure says so: a closed list of alert types, the shipped query alone trusted, a card built by the code, never an autonomous action

Azure's AI workloads, detection only

Correlation: an SSH session behind a root shell, a brute force that succeeds

Design: the model that reasons over a knowledge base that learns, for the enquiry before a decision: a closed catalogue of readings, a sheet of hypotheses per technique, the ransomware sheet first; the operator's nine decisions of 23/11 written in, among them the enquiry's memory per VM and rule, two paths for a lesson that relaxes, and the verdict per hypothesis on the console and on Discord

The catalogue of the enquiry's readings: the six queries of the enquiry out of the decision's module, each with its sentence, its parameters filled by the code (each with its check), its window (counted from the read until the enquiry anchors it on the signal), its latency, its author (the guest: provocable or forgeable) and what it can say under Linux and Windows; seven states never confused; the message to the model unchanged to the byte

The enquiry's knowledge base and its first sheet, ransomware: nine hypotheses, each with its sense, its effect, its reads, its sources and its state, validated against the catalogue; the weights by source and the asymmetry (what relaxes waits for a human, the model alone changes nothing, a proposed hypothesis never shown to it, the effect never learned); an empty store of evolutions; read by nothing in production yet

The enquiry's loop, at the harness only: the model picks its readings by id in the closed catalogue, then concludes; the code holds the budget (4 readings, 30 seconds of real time for the whole enquiry), runs the sheet's obligatory readings first, fills the VM from the registry, checks every citation against a line actually read, never says empty for a reading not served; the memory per VM and rule, dated, never in place of a reading of the day, and as usual received only on a human verdict, never on a grave technique; measured by a new genre of the harness, its turns timed and priced; wired to nothing in production

The three readings that judge a ransomware, served at the harness: the guest's disk writes minute by minute, the backup vault's jobs and its activity log, each window anchored on the signal's hour by the code, never by the model; waiting computed on what the source has ingested; an obligatory reading still waiting counted as a gap; a reading not served marked as such, never taken for one without object; the two discriminating hypotheses computed by the code; a read-only capture of an episode at the bench, out of the repository, its names pseudonymised, that the harness replays at the moment of the decision; wired to nothing in production

Why four readings came back empty at the bench, reading by reading: the backup vault's jobs now asked on the reading's own window, never on the service's default range, for the enquiry and the record alike; the per-process writes absent under Linux, a collection proposed; no sudo in those windows; the heartbeat's blind spot, its fix with the enquiry in production; read-only queries for the maintainer
The decision by the model: an enriched signal, memory, approved examples

Proof: what Glorfindel holds read once, NIC by NIC, in the test's world: a block gone by the content of its rules (a deny turned or left on a former address included), an isolation gone required said after every pass, a subnet that loses its NSG drawn; the product unchanged
What is no longer there, said: a perimeter pair on an NSG taken off its subnet read gone and said, never bypassed nor put back; a deleted VM's own card, nothing written for it
The recovery of a VM restored elsewhere read on Azure, and the isolation lifted on its own
The restore from the console: its rights read before the VM is touched, a refusal said whole
The restore refuses a time without its time zone, never taken for UTC: a moment given, a card or an isolation dated without one
The session cut under the quarantine followed on Azure: pending, refused, or sessions left open
A session cut announced pending is closed once, its outcome in the VM's thread and on the console's card
A disruptive action taken alone, once verified, makes one card to judge, and is said in the VM's thread
The Discord bot silent, the webhook announces an action taken alone, once, pinging the role
The webhook fallback in a thread of its own, each post bounded, three tries at most, and a session cut's closure said by it too, without a ping
Without the Discord bot, a session cut's closure and the reassertion's cards are queued for the webhook: no VM's lock and no reassertion pass waits for it

Without the Discord bot, a card posted at once is bounded, the name's resolution included: the graph's cycle never waits for a webhook beyond 10 s a card (25 s with a short 429), its secret never in the log; check-ttl posts its queued card outside the VM's lock and says it escalates, never releases

The isolation TTL read in one place, for the watch and check-ttl: 0 escalates every isolation at once, by the option as by the variable; a negative or unreadable TTL is refused by check-ttl (code 1, nothing escalated), and the watch says it and keeps 4 h, never stopping for it
A perimeter block whose check a throttled read cut short says its NICs unread, never reached behind another perimeter
A perimeter block says a NIC it couldn't read unread, beside the NICs proven open, never reached
A perimeter block whose own pair is gone at its check is never said blocked, the pair said in every branch
A block said gone because its NSG no longer governs the NIC is read there all the same: its rules deleted after the card was acknowledged are said again
Proof: two NSGs off the NIC are both read, and an unreadable one detached from it stays out of `rules_seen`; its five mutants all caught, the product unchanged

Proof: an acknowledged block drift stays said when one of its denies, still present, is turned into an allow since (a bypass, not a new disappearance), while a rule seen present and deleted since still breaks it; the product unchanged
A block whose rules are gone behind a quarantine that can't be judged (the configuration unreadable) is said gone, the NIC left unknown, never said open

Proof: an isolation that recorded itself whole, then was cut off in its session drain, supersedes the release it replaces; one cut off before writing anything leaves the release under way; the product unchanged

Proof: a release refused at the VM's lock during a race started nothing, and the isolation the reassertion puts back is not a release undone; replayed in the order macOS lists a directory, so the Linux CI keeps it; the oracle was wrong, the product unchanged

Proof: our rules on an NSG taken off a subnet and given to another VM, that nothing traces any more, are judged out of the unblock's reach; a NIC with no NSG at all stays in it; the oracle was wrong, the product unchanged
reset --from-azure takes off a block on the NSG its entry names, even once the customer took that NSG off the subnet; it said swept and left the rules with no trace
A block written whole again says anew its perimeter pair still on an NSG taken off the subnet, once the card that said it was acknowledged: a new block, a new episode; the pass had kept silent

Proof: a card that says an IP unblocked where a turned rule opens a way out past the perimeter, on port 22 or on UDP, is judged on every way to and from the attacker, by port and protocol; the oracle was too strict, the product unchanged

Proof: a bypass is judged only on the flows the hold's own denies close; an isolation left on the VM's former address is said gone, not bypassed, while a bypass of what a hold still holds is said; the product unchanged
Proof: the door's facts are tested on one clock, the isolation and its log, and their files pass again with the real clock a month ahead; the product unchanged

The bench tool that measures the lift, corrected on what the bench read: a failure said as Azure wrote it, an operation never masked, another resource named by its type

The lift into probation itself: the rule, the probation and its ports, the cards, the exercise as a real incident, measured on the bench
No output of the CLI meant for a human shows a subscription's id: Azure's errors, the decision rendered, pending, activate, release, unblock, snapshot, list, door, jobs
No message of the Discord bot nor of the webhook shows a subscription's id: the commands to copy name the VM by its group and name, which the CLI resolves on its own host or refuses
Every command to copy Glorfindel writes for a VM names it by its group and name, which the CLI resolves: the card of an action taken alone, the TUI, the console, the watch's cards, the CLI's hints

glorfindel isolate and glorfindel block: a containment by a human's hand from a terminal, the console's approval without the card, its guards and its check, the VM's enrollment zone said before the prompt and never a refusal; and no command Glorfindel proposes is invented
The TUI shows a card's steps, its line, the restore's screen and the feed through the CLI's masking: no subscription's id, each step cut after it is masked, never before

Design, settled: one watch per client over several subscriptions of one tenant, an added subscription treated like the watch's own; one identity for the watch, its roles declared per subscription in Terraform, the bench included; a subscription seen, read or in reach, declared and its rights read; no autonomy inherited, human_only by default; no write outside a subscription in reach, its withdrawal refused while a state is held there; the user's vault found VM by VM; the console explains the access to add, Glorfindel never grants itself a right

One watch reads and defends several subscriptions of one tenant, where it is declared and its rights are read, each treated like its own: a connector per subscription, the client's network and the addresses of each one, the response guarded per subscription, no write outside one in reach, the user's vault found VM by VM, the roles in Terraform, human_only by default

Design, settled: a classification of the VMs in three levels, essential, standard and quiet, declared by the operator, for the model's cost and the order of its queues: the reserve and the budget, the order of the grave calls at equal gravity, a grave never starved, the display; nothing of the detection, the response changed only by the essential VMs' reserve when the budget is tight, as today; quiet a display level only; no link with the mode; one assets: section replacing autonomy:, each entry with an optional mode and priority, the former format read until 1.0; the watch and the push held equal, the push never lowering a level; a relaxation of the file, a hand edit included, held until confirmed

The assets: section read strictly by the watch: each VM or pattern with an optional mode and an optional priority, essential, standard or quiet, each resolved on its own by the exact entry then the longest pattern; the former autonomy: format read in the same model with a note, both in one file refused; glorfindel config migrate at equal values, and back; the class of a change computed on the model, name by name; the writers keep the file's format; only a closed list of modules reads the priority, never decide nor the bot
The push to the hosted watch reads the assets: section as the watch reads it, writes the format its release reads, migrates it and back, and never lowers a VM's level
The VMs' classification in force everywhere: an order between the VMs in the gate for the grave detections, the former format retired at 1.0

Design: the operator's nine decisions on the record of an isolation, and the bench measure that compared the host and the guest on the same minute

The decision noted on each cycle's debug line: the model called, its sampling, the settings in force, the version of Glorfindel and the fingerprint of the rule that fired; the memory and the message to the model unchanged to the byte
The record of an isolation itself: the platform's context, the host's second opinion, the recurrence, on the card and in Discord

The record of an isolation read on Azure, after the action: the activity log around the signal, the vault's jobs, the instance view, the host's metrics and the health, each window anchored on the signal, unreadable never empty, never for a detection with no VM; on its own budget of ARM calls, apart from the detection's on Log Analytics, a critical object never without its record, the hourly ceiling gone

The record of an isolation, step 0: at the end of each isolation, and of each card that proposes one, the facts the cycle already holds, each with its source, its author and its state, written with no call; at most six an hour, kept 30 days after the lift, never shown to the model

The record of a block, decided in the design: a block executed alone has no record, and no exception is needed for a private address, which is never blocked; a detection with no attributed VM will never be read on Azure for its record; the hourly ceiling to be asked again
